area_definition: Architectural scheduled floor area is the reporting reference. AAD semantic floorPlate is an explicitly inferred design outline fitted within ±0.01 m²; matching floor area DOES NOT verify every perimeter segment.

combined.notice: The 3D AAD project data models represent Block B only; Block A is not modeled and is not counted as geometry.

modeling_assumptions.stair_geometry: Schematic 3D room/partition indication only; treads/risers and load path not source verified
modeling_assumptions.room_identity: DXF/TEXT names allocated to derived graph faces plus named AI-designed corridors, suites and adaptable rooms
modeling_assumptions.openings: Host wall coordinates chosen by designer AI where DXF symbols could not be identified as verified BIM openings
modeling_assumptions.vertical_datum: Relative; no surveyed level, structural plinth or RL asserted

boundary: Architectural 2D plots retain direct DXF dimensional evidence. The revised AAD project model has metric and semantic assumptions clearly recorded. This is not analysis, detailing, IFC/BIM equivalence, engineer certification, IFC/issued-for-construction clearance, or structural approval.
integration: Project page selects hosted project data via existing AAD Studio projectModel parameter; other projects reuse same engine.
